Question: Assalamu alaykum warah matuallahi wabarakatuh What is the best durud to send to Muhammad(saw). i read on a islamic website and i want to know if it true or not that by sending durud to Muhammad(saw) Allah subha nahuwa ta'allah helps a person in his worldy need ie job, money and what ever problem they are facing is solved easily. Jazakallah. Answer ID: 16604 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1560/1474/B=1430) The best durood is the Durood Ibrahimi recited in salah. Whatever you have read at the website is correct. You should recite durood as much as possible with good intention. It is best solution for all kinds of trouble. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
